content: भ्रंश् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> €4 <ab>P.</ab> (भ्रंशते, भ्रश्यति, भ्रष्ट; with <ab>abl.</ab> in most cases) .²1 To fall or drop down, tumble; हस्ताद् भ्रष्टमिदं बिसाभरणम् <ls>Ś. 3. 25</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 130</ls>; <ls>Śi. 18. 21</ls>. .²2 To fall from, deviate or swerve from, stray from; यूथाद् भ्रष्टः <ls>H. 4</ls>; <ls>R. 14. 16</ls>. .²3 To be deprived of, lose; बभ्रंशेऽसौ धृतेस्ततः <ls>Bk. 14. 71</ls>; <ls>Pt. 2. 108</ls>, <ls n="Pt.">4. 37</ls>. .²4 To escape, flee from; संग्रामाद् बभ्रशुः केचित् <ls>Bk. 14. 105</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">15. 59</ls>. .²5 To decline, decay, decrease; विवर्णवदनश्चासीत् किंचिदभ्रश्यत स्वनः <ls>Rām. 6. 95. 45</ls>. .²6 To disappear, vanish, depart; द्रवति हृदयमन्तर्भ्रश्यतीवान्तरात्मा <ls>Māl. 8. 12</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (भ्रंशयति-ते) .²1 To cause to fall, throw or cast down. .²2 To deprive of. .²3 To ruin, overturn. .²4 To cause to disappear or vanish. .²5 To expel.
